question: Does the scoped coverage unused-slot fix recover suitable news direct labels without new known false or unknown directs, under the same DeepSeek/Qwen budgets?
candidate: new opt-in v12 coverage validation; same retrieval/news/date/app/source/audit protections
stage: limited development/live comparison, not general qualification
source_policy: Original query only, Seznam/Naver; persistent two MCP processes, alternate casewise arm order, no retry/reset after blocks. App/download queries deliberately absent; known blocked andro.io must not be contacted or used for original validation.
inputs: live paired sources/HTML, not frozen identical inputs; current source/title/body drift retained
arm_order: baseline,fixed for odd ordinal; fixed,baseline for even ordinal; calls sequential to avoid shared Qwen contention
stop: Complete16 primary calls if no block; any actual source/host block stops both remaining primary paths because a safe shared trusted block mask is unavailable. Remaining case/arms recorded not_run, no restart/retry.

annotation.blind: source-only returned URL union, no arm/model label/audit; partial and inaccessible originals retained

evidence: short exact source quotes with paths/URLs

annotation.grade2: Specific source article matching requested city/topic/site and publication window, read original/full body and full own publication date; neither model direct nor runtime eligibility is gold.
annotation.grade1: Navigation/feed or useful incomplete material, not a specific verified eligible publication; boundaries remain explicit.
annotation.grade0: Clear wrong place/topic/period or app advertisement for news-reading intent; card-only conclusions marked provisional.
annotation.unknown: Original unavailable or insufficient/ambiguous source to judge; unknown is not negative and never FP.
date_rules: Own publication full date, no year inferred from URL/query/copyright
Ignore modified/event/adjacent teaser dates for article publication
Future publication may not be verified as current
Historical query uses its explicit month
Source date/time offsets converted consistently to Moscow calendar
annotation.dedup: Canonical URL per case; same event/publisher cluster reported separately, not independent confirmation

recall.denominator: Every grade2 known-positive case/URL in the returned union of BOTH arms for cases executed in BOTH arms; each arm uses the same denominator
recall.numerator: Known-positive union URLs returned as direct by this arm within those paired cases
recall.fn: Known-positive union denominator minus this arm numerator, including a known-positive URL only returned by the other arm
recall.undefined: null with zero known positives or before gold; no made-up0/100 score
recall.unknowns: Unknown originals excluded from known-positive denominator and reported by union/arm; unknown direct separate from FP
recall.limits: Conditional on observed returned union, not unseen candidate pool or full-web recall; live input inequality prevents isolated causal attribution

measurements: all16 case/arm status, failures and empty results
qualified pages@10 and known TP/FP/FN/unknown direct IDs
paired conditional direct recall for current news and all news
old2source recovery separate, not fresh set
coverage unused requirement errors and recorded repairs
source/generative/read/Qwen budgets and wall time; no money guess from public MCP
quality_gates: all16 primary captures and complete source annotation coverage
no new known unsuitable direct IDs versus same-query baseline
public OpenRouter model, Qwen name and v11/v12 evidence versions match the intended profile
usefulness_gate: Positive paired direct-recall gain with nonzero known-positive union, separately from guard safety; no general acceptance from a tiny set

extra_validation.tool: existing unchanged Rust net.rs fetch_guarded standalone reader, root orchestrates
extra_validation.rule: Direct URLs first, then successful observed child links regardless runtime kind, then other returned URLs if cap remains; no exact URL repeated in validation, no source already failed retried, andro.io and newly blocked hosts excluded; strict original origin before every hop
extra_validation.budget: separate from primary4reads, report actual HTTP attempts, failures, original/body readability
extra_validation.method_limit: Source originals after primary inference before blind-gold join; primary raw HTML/model inputs unavailable in public MCP. Not byte-identical source replay.

old_regression_scope: Known two Nizhny Novgorod sources and exact prior failure evidence are development/component checks; never pooled into fresh holdout scores
